datasets.title: SHDI
datasets.description: The subnational Human Development Index (SHDI) is calculated from three dimensions: education, health and standard of living. All indicators used for the SHDI calculations are available, including sex-disaggregated data on expected years of schooling, mean years of schooling, life expectancy, and gross national income (GNI) per capita [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the STAC catalog climate-risk-stac (https://climate-risk-data.github.io/climate-risk-stac/)]
